_comment: STATIC HOLDINGS — quantities the server injects into the sheet, overriding anything the model guesses. UPDATE THIS FILE whenever you buy or sell, then push (Vercel redeploys automatically). 'qty' goes into column F, 'avg' into column H. Set 'avg' to null if you don't track a cost basis — the I/J change formulas are then left blank rather than showing #DIV/0!. ETF qty is share count and avg is USD per share. FX qty is the amount of foreign currency held and avg is IDR per unit at cost.
